prompt:
FORMAT: 4 seconds, 1 shot, vertical 9:16, 24 fps.
STYLE: Layered card-stock paper cut-out: warm cream walls, a teal-and-sand kitchen, soft lamp shadows under every piece, cut edges catching the light, animated on twos with a gentle stop-motion jitter. Everything is handmade paper and card: visible paper fibres, slightly uneven cut edges, small soft drop shadows between layers, matte surfaces, no plastic shine, no photoreal skin.
CAMERA: 35 mm lens, eye level, a slow steady push-in of about 10% over the whole shot, ending on a medium two-shot of Juno and the fern.
MUSIC: FALSE. No music, no score. Diegetic sound only: paper rustle, a soft room tone.
CUT POLICY: one single continuous shot; no cuts, no dissolves, no speed ramps.
MOTION SPEED AND QUALITY: real-time speed for every movement with the slight stepped rhythm of stop-motion on twos; natural weight; never floaty, never jerky; no slow motion.
REFERENCES:
- reference image 1: STRICT JUNO IDENTITY: face, hair (dark brown bun with loose strands), body proportions and costume (rust-orange t-shirt, blue-grey cuffed trousers, cream flat shoes) exactly as shown.
- reference image 2: STRICT KITCHEN ENVIRONMENT, view 1: window above the counter, sage-green cabinets, open shelves, pendant lamp; materials, colours and lighting exactly as shown.
- reference image 3: STRICT KITCHEN ENVIRONMENT, view 2: the same kitchen from a wider angle; use it to keep the room consistent when the camera sees more of it.
- reference image 4: EXACT SPRIGLY BOTTLE: green body, yellow cap, cream label printed SPRIGLY; shape, proportions and colours exactly as shown; never redesign it.
- reference image 5: CONTEXTUAL POSITIONING ONLY: a grey blockout sketch; use it only for who stands where, spacing, the fern and bottle placement and the camera side. NOT a starting frame; take no colours, shapes or style from it.
Preserve complete character, product and location consistency with the references throughout the shot.
SETTING AND BLOCKING: Sunday morning light from the window. Juno stands on the left third of the frame, full figure, feet on the floor, three-quarter to the right, facing the counter. On the counter at the right: a small blue pot with a droopy fern whose fronds hang limp over the rim; at the far right end of the counter the small Sprigly bottle stands upright, unnoticed, in soft focus. The counter edge runs across the lower middle of the frame; the window is centred above it. Keep the upper third of the frame calm and uncluttered.
ACTION: 0–1 s: Juno and the fern face each other in silence, like a standoff; Juno's arms hang, her brows pull down, her mouth flat. 1–2.5 s: she narrows her eyes and leans her head slightly forward; one droopy frond twitches and sags a little lower, as if answering. 2.5–4 s: she exhales through her nose, shoulders dropping a fraction; the fern does not move. Small, restrained acting: no big gestures, no turning to camera.
CAST RULE: exactly 1 person (Juno). Nobody else in frame.
NO TEXT: no subtitles, no captions, no on-screen words, no logos other than the printed SPRIGLY label.

CONTINUITY: the Sprigly bottle stays exactly where it is at the right end of the counter (it will be revealed later); the fern stays droopy; the same morning light as the kitchen references.
